title: Output as the concatenation of step emissions
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $y$ be a Boolean word, and let $T\in\mathbb{N}$. The output after $T$ steps is the chronological concatenation of the optional bits emitted by the snapshots at times $0,1,\ldots,T-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
replaced: For every machine, input $y$, and horizon $T$, the physical output after $T$ steps is the chronological concatenation of the optional emissions of the snapshots at times $0, \dots, T-1$, including the write on a halting transition.
